theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lipschitz_pushforward_homotopy
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ (push : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (homot : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → push k (fun x => x) X = X) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → push k F (X - Y) = push k F X - push k F Y ∧ homot k F G (X - Y) = homot k F G X - homot k F G Y) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G F' G' : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → LipschitzWith Λ F' → LipschitzWith Λ G' → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → EqOn F F' X.support → EqOn G G' X.support → push k F X = push k F' X ∧ homot k F G X = homot k F' G' X) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (push k F X).mass ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * X.mass ∧ (push k F X).support ⊆ F '' X.support ∧ (∀ δ : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ X.support, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ δ) → (homot k F G X).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ * (2 * (Λ : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ k * X.mass) ∧ (homot k F G X).support ⊆ {y : Euclid P | ∃ x ∈ X.support, ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, y = F x + t • (G x - F x)}) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → (push (k + 1) F X).boundary = push k F X.boundary ∧ push (k + 1) G X - push (k + 1) F X - homot k F G X.boundary = (homot (k + 1) F G X).boundary ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (push (k + 1) F X) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (homot (k + 1) F G X))) ∧ ∀ (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → push 0 G X - push 0 F X = (homot 0 F G X).boundary
